classification: harness initialization failure caused by the Seatbelt write boundary
failure_point: pytest_configure logging plugin initialization, before collection
cause_and_correction: pytest's default log_file setting opens /dev/null. The exact Seatbelt profile allows writes only under the arm-specific output directory. A retry addendum may direct pytest's log_file setting to an explicit file in that allowed directory; do not relax the sandbox profile.
retry_authority: No retry under the frozen protocol v1 addendum. A new append-only, hash-bound addendum must be pushed before any retry; the original invocation remains preserved and consumed.
